extracted.name: Willis Farm Applesauce
extracted.description: This Willis Farm applesauce is a uniquely colored applesauce from Red Hots spicy cinnamon candies, adding extra flavor to this quick-and-easy recipe.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup cinnamon candies (such as Red Hots®)
instruction_lines: Combine apples and water in a large pot over medium heat; bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in cinnamon candies and sugar; return to a simmer and cook until candies melt, about 15 minutes. Set aside off heat until mixture cools, about 15 minutes.
Mash apple mixture with a potato masher until no large chunks remain.
